newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Independent Newspaper Hldgs to sell Sowetan stake.
newsitem.headline: Independent Newspaper Hldgs to sell Sowetan stake.

text.p: Independent Newspapers Holdings Ltd said on Wednesday that it had agreed in principle to sell its 42.5 percent stake in The Sowetan newspaper to New Africa Investments Ltd.
The deal values The Sowetan, a South African English-language tabloid daily newspaper, at 150 million rand, the company said in a statement.
Independent Newspapers Holdings Ltd is 60 percent owned by Ireland's Independent Newspapers Plc.
New Africa Investments already holds a 52.5 percent stake in The Sowetan which it acquired from Argus Newspapers in 1994.
Independent Newspapers later invested in Argus which has since been renamed Independent Newspapers Holdings Ltd.

Liam Healy, chief executive of Independent Newspapers, said the price achieved for the Sowetan stake was "very satisfactory" and said the group's experience since investing in South Africa had been a very good one.

"Independent Holdings Ltd has eleven of the fifteen major colour presses in the entire country and with this capacity is now looking seriously at the possibility of launching its own English-language tabloid to circulate in the main cities and townships," he said.
